about: The normaliser (OR-14, OR-V3, OR-27). Each case gives raw JSON from a run, the run's runtime errors (OR-V3 clause a: stored results of failed leaf jobs that executed a script) and the normalised JSON. In strings, ${name} stands for the id of the walked job named in ids. Masking is narrow: only walked ids are replaced, a stack is masked only with runtime-error provenance, and only the NUL InternalErr loses its location.

cases.name: OR-14/b: a returned job id is rewritten to its placeholder
OR-V3/c: the placeholder does not depend on the raw id
OR-V3/a: an unknown UUID is preserved
a walked id in a member name is rewritten too
OR-V3/b: user data that looks like an error is preserved
OR-12/a: a failed script leaf's stored error has its stack masked (clause a)

cases.name: clause b: a value deep-equal to a runtime error, in another member order, is masked
clause b: a failure handler's input carries the propagated error
clause b: a handler that returns the error it received
OR-V3/d: a handler's own result keeps its user data next to a runtime error
a value with one more member than the runtime error is not masked
a runtime error that is not an object masks nothing and does not stop the others
OR-27/a: the NUL InternalErr loses its job id and its location
